context.caption: System context and external actors
context.alt: Candidates and administrators use JobPilot, which reads job feeds, calls a model with masked prompts and distinguishes a live form handoff from a tested local submission.

use-cases.caption: Candidate and operational use cases
use-cases.alt: Candidates manage their profile, search, tailor, review and track applications; a candidate or scheduler can request a refresh, while an administrator can recover an embedding run.

function-scope.caption: Implemented functions and submission limits
function-scope.alt: The workspace and platform functions are implemented, but only the local fake ATS supports an approved submission with verification; the live Greenhouse assist path stops at handoff.

application-state.type: UML state machine diagram with transition key
application-state.caption: Tracked application states and permitted transitions
application-state.alt: The prepare route creates a prepared tracker row; the arrows and key together cover all legal tracker transitions, including verification rollback and human-only outcomes, without mixing in run or approval states.

refresh-sequence.caption: Durable corpus refresh acceptance and polling
refresh-sequence.alt: HTTP 202 identifies a new or existing durable refresh; a separate worker claims the item, persists the listings and any child indexing work, and exposes progress for later polling.

refresh-activity.caption: Corpus refresh and indexing checkpoints
refresh-activity.alt: The worker filters listings and commits rows with any child indexing work, then credits an embedding only when its stored content hash matches and the worker still holds the lease.

approval-sequence.caption: Fake ATS approval and execution
approval-sequence.alt: Approval returns HTTP 202 before the worker executes the stored fake-ATS packet; on redelivery an attempt marker without an outcome triggers human review instead of another submission.

tailoring-activity.caption: Grounded résumé tailoring and document delivery
tailoring-activity.alt: The pipeline grounds the draft in a stored profile and listing, strips unsupported content, records whether the original document could be edited and reports ATS fit without submitting anything.

nav.caption: Public pages and signed-in console routes
nav.alt: Public landing and sign-in pages lead to the console, where matches and approvals have dedicated routes and each tracked application has its own questions page.

communication.caption: Messages in a successful fake ATS approval
communication.alt: Numbered messages on object links separate the console’s accepted decision from the worker’s claim, durable attempt marker, local submission and evidence-backed result.

interaction-overview.caption: Preparation, decision and evidence interactions
interaction-overview.alt: Live Greenhouse preparation ends at human handoff, while a fake-ATS packet can proceed from a recorded approval to worker execution and a separate evidence check.

timing.caption: Lease ownership across embedding run recovery
timing.alt: Ordinal events show an expired lease and stale run, an explicit administrator resume, and a new claim whose token prevents the previous worker from committing.
